vb_textbox.text: The game appears to run in patterns, but these seem to change throughout. It may be that particular colours earn more mushrooms, the side they are on, the speed at which you choose, or the appearance of the gnomes. Try different methods when attempting to discover what finds the most mushrooms. Make sure you have your fingers over the correct keys to reduce the risk of running out of time: s for left, k for right, and space for the basket. Use the break time to help maintain concentration levels.
